units: <cite ref="Nedarim 9b:5">Ned. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>וקְווּצּוֹתָיו סדורות תלתלים</he> and his curly hair was arranged in locks; Y. ib. I, 36ᵈ bot.; <cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 4:7">Tosef. Naz. IV, 7</cite>; Y. ib. I, end, 51ᶜ; Bab.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 26:1">Pesik. R. s. 26</cite> <he>העמדת … בעל ק׳ … מסלסל קווצותיו</he> thou didst put up for them Elijah, the curly-headed man, and they sneered and laughed at him, (saying,) behold &c., v. <cite ref="O01011"><he>סִלְסֵל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 262:1">Yalk. Jer. 262</cite>.—Masc. form: <he>קְווּצִּין</he>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>תפיסת קורצין</he> (corr. acc.; ed. Wil. <he>תפיסות</he>) the front hair cut so as to form ‘a handle of the locks’ (a gentile custom, v. <cite ref="B00843"><he>בְּלוּרִית</he></cite>).
